# Imports

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)
library(lubridate)
```

# Get Pokemon TCG API and Build our Dataset

API documentation found [here]("https://docs.pokemontcg.io")

```{r}
TEST_SET  <- NULL           
PAGE_SIZE <- 50
api_key   <- Sys.getenv("POKEMONTCG_API_KEY")
snap_date <- Sys.Date()    
                           
dir.create("data/raw", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
 
if (!nzchar(api_key)) message("No API key found. It will work, but slower and less reliably.")
 
# API helper with retries 
pt_get <- function(endpoint, query = list()) {
  req <- request("https://api.pokemontcg.io/v2")
  req <- req_url_path_append(req, endpoint)
  req <- req_url_query(req, !!!query)
  req <- req_timeout(req, 120)
  req <- req_retry(
    req,
    max_tries    = 6,
    is_transient = function(resp) resp_status(resp) %in% c(429, 500, 502, 503, 504),
    backoff      = function(attempt) 2^attempt     # 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 seconds
  )
  if (nzchar(api_key)) req <- req_headers(req, `X-Api-Key` = api_key)
 
  resp <- req_perform(req)
  resp_body_json(resp)
}
 
# checks if the API is alive
message("Checking API...")
ping <- tryCatch(pt_get("sets", list(pageSize = 1)), error = function(e) {
  message("API check failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
  NULL
})
if (is.null(ping)) {
  stop("The Pokemon TCG API isn't responding right now (server errors). ",
       "Wait 15-30 minutes and run again. Nothing is lost.")
}
message("API is up.")
 
# Sets (2010 onward) 
sets <- pt_get("sets", list(pageSize = 250))$data |>
  map_dfr(\(s) tibble(
    set_id        = s$id,
    set_name      = s$name,
    series        = s$series,
    release_date  = ymd(s$releaseDate),
    printed_total = s$printedTotal %||% NA_integer_,
    total         = s$total %||% NA_integer_
  )) |>
  filter(release_date >= ymd("2020-01-01"))
 
if (!is.null(TEST_SET)) sets <- filter(sets, set_id == TEST_SET)
message("Sets to fetch: ", nrow(sets))
 
# Download cards per set (cached; resumable)
cache_path <- function(set_id) file.path("data/raw", paste0(set_id, "_", snap_date, ".rds"))
 
get_set_cards <- function(set_id) {
  cache <- cache_path(set_id)
  if (file.exists(cache)) return(readRDS(cache))
 
  out <- list(); page <- 1
  repeat {
    res <- pt_get("cards", list(q = paste0("set.id:", set_id),
                                page = page, pageSize = PAGE_SIZE))
    out <- c(out, res$data)
    if (length(res$data) == 0 || length(out) >= res$totalCount) break
    page <- page + 1
  }
  saveRDS(out, cache)
  out
}
 
download_sets <- function(ids, labels) {
  failed <- character()
  n <- length(ids)
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    id <- ids[i]
    cached <- file.exists(cache_path(id))
    message(sprintf("[%d/%d] %s - %s  (%s)%s", i, n, id, labels[i],
                    format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), if (cached) "  [cached]" else ""))
    res <- tryCatch(get_set_cards(id), error = function(e) {
      message("   FAILED: ", conditionMessage(e))
      NULL
    })
    if (is.null(res)) failed <- c(failed, id) else message("   ", length(res), " cards")
    if (!cached) Sys.sleep(1)
  }
  failed
}
 
failed <- download_sets(sets$set_id, sets$set_name)
 
# One automatic second pass for anything that failed
if (length(failed) > 0) {
  message("\n", length(failed), " set(s) failed. Waiting 60s, then retrying once...")
  Sys.sleep(60)
  failed <- download_sets(failed, sets$set_name[match(failed, sets$set_id)])
}
 
if (length(failed) > 0) {
  message("\nStill failing (rerun the script later; finished sets are cached):")
  print(failed)
}
 
# Load everything that downloaded successfully
have <- sets$set_id[file.exists(cache_path(sets$set_id))]
if (length(have) == 0) stop("No sets downloaded. Try again later.")
raw_cards <- unlist(lapply(have, function(id) readRDS(cache_path(id))), recursive = FALSE)
message("\nLoaded ", length(raw_cards), " cards from ", length(have), " sets.")
 
# Flatten into two tidy tables 
num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x %||% NA))
 
cards <- map_dfr(raw_cards, function(x) {
  tibble(
    card_id      = x$id,
    set_id       = x$set$id,
    number       = x$number,
    name         = x$name,
    supertype    = x$supertype,
    subtypes     = paste(unlist(x$subtypes), collapse = "|"),
    hp           = num(x$hp),
    poke_type    = unlist(x$types)[1] %||% NA_character_,
    evolves_from = x$evolvesFrom %||% NA_character_,
    rarity       = x$rarity %||% NA_character_,
    artist       = x$artist %||% NA_character_,
    retreat_cost = num(x$convertedRetreatCost),
    n_attacks    = length(x$attacks),
    dex_number   = unlist(x$nationalPokedexNumbers)[1] %||% NA_integer_
  )
})
 
prices <- map_dfr(raw_cards, function(x) {
  p <- x$tcgplayer$prices
  if (is.null(p)) return(NULL)
  variant_names <- names(p)
  rows <- vector("list", length(p))
  for (i in seq_along(p)) {
    v <- p[[i]]
    rows[[i]] <- tibble(
      card_id        = x$id,
      variant        = variant_names[i],
      market         = num(v$market),
      low            = num(v$low),
      mid            = num(v$mid),
      high           = num(v$high),
      tcg_updated_at = x$tcgplayer$updatedAt %||% NA_character_,
      snapshot_date  = snap_date
    )
  }
  bind_rows(rows)
})
 
# Join into one modeling table 
df <- prices |>
  inner_join(cards, by = "card_id") |>
  left_join(sets, by = "set_id") |>
  filter(!is.na(market), market > 0) |>
  mutate(
    log_price  = log(market),
    age_years  = as.numeric(snap_date - release_date) / 365.25,
    number_int = suppressWarnings(as.integer(str_extract(number, "\\d+"))),
    is_secret  = !is.na(number_int) & !is.na(printed_total) & number_int > printed_total,
    is_ex_gx_v = str_detect(subtypes, "\\b(EX|GX|V|VMAX|VSTAR|ex|MEGA)\\b"),
    across(c(rarity, variant, poke_type, supertype, series), as.factor)
  )
 
# Save
write_csv(cards, "data/cards.csv")
write_csv(sets,  "data/sets.csv")
write_csv(df,    paste0("data/dataset_", snap_date, ".csv"))
 
hist_file <- "data/price_history.csv"
write_csv(prices, hist_file, append = file.exists(hist_file))
```
